shortDescription: Import Outbound Inspection certificate for HTTPS inspection.

options.name: auto_publish_session
options.description: Publish the current session if changes have been performed after task completes.

options.name: base64_certificate
options.description:
Certificate file encoded in base64.
Valid file format, p12.

options.name: base64_password
options.description: Password (encoded in Base64 with padding) for the certificate file.

options.name: color
options.description: Color of the object. Should be one of existing colors. Available from R82 management version.

options.name: comments
options.description: Comments string. Available from R82 management version.

options.name: details_level
options.description: The level of detail for some of the fields in the response can vary from showing only the UID value of the object to a fully detailed representation of the object.

options.name: ignore_errors
options.description: Apply changes ignoring errors. You won't be able to publish such a changes. If ignore-warnings flag was omitted - warnings will also be ignored. Available from R82 management version.

options.name: ignore_warnings
options.description: Apply changes ignoring warnings. By Setting this parameter to 'true' default outbound certificate can be replaced. Available from R82 management version.

options.name: is_default
options.description: Is the certificate is the default certificate. Available from R82 management version.

options.name: name
options.description: Object name. Must be unique in the domain. Available from R82 management version.

options.name: tags
options.description: Collection of tag identifiers. Available from R82 management version.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.
